{"test_name":"Ledger_2283_Objection1","test_code":"using System;\nusing System.IO;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator.Analyzers;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Diagnostics;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\n\npublic class Ledger_2283_Objection1\n{\n    private static async Task<(MetadataReference LibReference, ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> BaseReferences)> CreateReferencedAssemblyAsync(string libSource)\n    {\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> frameworkReferences = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> baseReferences = frameworkReferences.AddRange(ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack));\n\n        CSharpCompilation libCompilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"Lib\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(libSource, new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest)) },\n            baseReferences,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        using MemoryStream peStream = new();\n        var emitResult = libCompilation.Emit(peStream);\n        Assert.True(emitResult.Success, string.Join(Environment.NewLine, emitResult.Diagnostics));\n\n        return (MetadataReference.CreateFromImage(peStream.ToArray()), baseReferences);\n    }\n\n    private static CSharpCompilation CreateAppCompilation(string appSource, MetadataReference libReference, ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> baseReferences)\n    {\n        return CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"App\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(appSource, new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest)) },\n            baseReferences.Add(libReference),\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task ClosedGenericValueTypesFromReferencedAssembly_GenerateResolverAndDoNotCrash()\n    {\n        const string libSource = @\"using MessagePack;\n\nnamespace Lib\n{\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public partial record struct Item<T>([property: Key(0)] string Key);\n\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public readonly partial record struct ReadonlyItem<T>([property: Key(0)] T Value);\n\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public partial struct PlainStruct<T>\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public T Value { get; set; }\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public struct CtorStruct<T>\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public T Value { get; }\n\n        [SerializationConstructor]\n        public CtorStruct(T value)\n        {\n            this.Value = value;\n        }\n    }\n}\";\n\n        const string appSource = @\"using Lib;\nusing MessagePack;\n\nnamespace App\n{\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public sealed partial record Cmd([property: Key(0)] string Scope)\n    {\n        [Key(1)]\n        public Item<int> Member { get; init; }\n\n        [Key(2)]\n        public ReadonlyItem<string> ReadonlyMember { get; init; }\n\n        [Key(3)]\n        public PlainStruct<long> PlainMember { get; init; }\n\n        [Key(4)]\n        public CtorStruct<bool> CtorMember { get; init; }\n    }\n}\";\n\n        var (libReference, baseReferences) = await CreateReferencedAssemblyAsync(libSource);\n        CSharpCompilation appCompilation = CreateAppCompilation(appSource, libReference, baseReferences);\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(appCompilation, out Compilation outputCompilation, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n\n        Assert.Empty(generatorDiagnostics);\n        Assert.Empty(runResult.Diagnostics);\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, result => Assert.Null(result.Exception));\n        Assert.Contains(\n            runResult.Results.SelectMany(r => r.GeneratedSources),\n            s => s.HintName.Contains(\"GeneratedMessagePackResolver\", StringComparison.Ordinal));\n\n        var compileErrors = outputCompilation.GetDiagnostics().Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error).ToArray();\n        Assert.Empty(compileErrors);\n\n        ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> analyzerDiagnostics = await appCompilation\n            .WithAnalyzers(ImmutableArray.Create<DiagnosticAnalyzer>(new MsgPack00xMessagePackAnalyzer()))\n            .GetAnalyzerDiagnosticsAsync();\n\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(analyzerDiagnostics, d => d.Id == \"AD0001\");\n        Assert.Empty(analyzerDiagnostics);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task ClosedGenericValueTypeFromReferencedAssembly_UnkeyedMember_DoesNotCrashOrLeakDiagnostic()\n    {\n        const string libSource = @\"using MessagePack;\n\nnamespace Lib\n{\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public partial struct ItemWithUnkeyed<T>\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public T Value { get; set; }\n\n        public int MissingKey { get; set; }\n    }\n}\";\n\n        const string appSource = @\"using Lib;\nusing MessagePack;\n\nnamespace App\n{\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public sealed partial record Cmd([property: Key(0)] string Scope)\n    {\n        [Key(1)]\n        public ItemWithUnkeyed<int> Member { get; init; }\n    }\n}\";\n\n        var (libReference, baseReferences) = await CreateReferencedAssemblyAsync(libSource);\n        CSharpCompilation appCompilation = CreateAppCompilation(appSource, libReference, baseReferences);\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(appCompilation, out _, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n\n        Assert.Empty(generatorDiagnostics);\n        Assert.Empty(runResult.Diagnostics);\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, result => Assert.Null(result.Exception));\n        Assert.Contains(\n            runResult.Results.SelectMany(r => r.GeneratedSources),\n            s => s.HintName.Contains(\"GeneratedMessagePackResolver\", StringComparison.Ordinal));\n\n        ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> analyzerDiagnostics = await appCompilation\n            .WithAnalyzers(ImmutableArray.Create<DiagnosticAnalyzer>(new MsgPack00xMessagePackAnalyzer()))\n            .GetAnalyzerDiagnosticsAsync();\n\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(analyzerDiagnostics, d => d.Id == \"AD0001\");\n        Assert.Empty(analyzerDiagnostics);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task ClosedGenericValueTypeFromReferencedAssembly_NullKey_DoesNotCrashAnalyzer()\n    {\n        const string libSource = @\"using MessagePack;\n\nnamespace Lib\n{\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public partial struct ItemWithNullKey<T>\n    {\n        [Key((string)null)]\n        public T Value { get; set; }\n    }\n}\";\n\n        const string appSource = @\"using Lib;\nusing MessagePack;\n\nnamespace App\n{\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public sealed partial record Cmd([property: Key(0)] string Scope)\n    {\n        [Key(1)]\n        public ItemWithNullKey<int> Member { get; init; }\n    }\n}\";\n\n        var (libReference, baseReferences) = await CreateReferencedAssemblyAsync(libSource);\n        CSharpCompilation appCompilation = CreateAppCompilation(appSource, libReference, baseReferences);\n\n        ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> analyzerDiagnostics = await appCompilation\n            .WithAnalyzers(ImmutableArray.Create<DiagnosticAnalyzer>(new MsgPack00xMessagePackAnalyzer()))\n            .GetAnalyzerDiagnosticsAsync();\n\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(analyzerDiagnostics, d => d.Id == \"AD0001\");\n        Assert.Empty(analyzerDiagnostics);\n    }\n}\n"}
